column1: 到中国留学，需要准备什么证件和材料？|What documents and materials do you need to prepare to study in China?|我需要准备护照。|I need to prepare my passport.|我需要准备护照和照片。|I need to prepare my passport and photos.|我会先问老师，再准备需要的东西。|I will ask the teacher first, then prepare what I need.

你打算学习什么专业？为什么？|What major do you plan to study, and why?|我打算学中文，因为我喜欢中国。|I plan to study Chinese because I like China.|我想学英语，因为我想做老师。|I want to study English because I want to be a teacher.|我想学历史，因为我喜欢了解以前的事情。|I want to study history because I like learning about the past.

你觉得租房子好，还是买房子好？为什么？|Do you think renting or buying a home is better, and why?|我觉得先住学校好，因为方便。|I think living at school first is good because it is convenient.|我想买房子，因为想一直住在这里。|I want to buy a home because I want to stay here.|我现在钱不多，所以先找一个小房间。|I do not have much money now, so I will find a small room first.

如果租房子，你喜欢租什么样的房子？|If you rent, what kind of home would you like?|我喜欢离学校近的房子。|I like homes close to school.|我想住在安静的地方。|I want to live somewhere quiet.|我喜欢有大房间的房子，因为家人多。|I like homes with large rooms because I have a large family.

你在网上购物吗？如果你网购，说说你是怎么进行网购的；如果你不网购，为什么？|Do you shop online? If so, explain how; if not, why not?|我在网上买书。先看价格，再给钱。|I buy books online. I check the price first, then pay.|我不在网上买东西，我喜欢去商店看一看。|I do not buy things online; I like looking in shops.|我有时在网上买衣服，先看看别人的介绍。|I sometimes buy clothes online and first read other people's descriptions.

用手机时，你会怎样保护自己的信息？|How do you protect your information when using your phone?|我不给不认识的人看我的手机。|I do not show my phone to strangers.|我不告诉不认识的人我住在哪里。|I do not tell strangers where I live.|有不清楚的地方，我先问家人。|If something is unclear, I ask my family first.

你帮助过别人吗？你是怎么提供帮助的？|Have you helped someone? How did you help?|我帮过朋友。他不会中文，我帮他问路。|I helped a friend. He could not speak Chinese, so I asked for directions for him.|我帮妈妈买过菜，也帮她做过饭。|I have helped my mother buy vegetables and cook.|有同学找不到教室，我带他去了。|A classmate could not find the classroom, so I took him there.

你最常用的出行方式是什么？为什么？|How do you usually travel, and why?|我常坐地铁，因为很快。|I often take the subway because it is fast.|我走路上学，因为学校离家近。|I walk to school because it is close to home.|我喜欢骑自行车，因为可以锻炼身体。|I like cycling because it gives me exercise.

你吃过哪些中国菜？觉得怎么样？|Which Chinese dishes have you eaten, and what did you think?|我吃过中国的面条，觉得很好吃。|I have eaten Chinese noodles and thought they were delicious.|我吃过鱼和鸡肉，都很好吃。|I have eaten fish and chicken; both were delicious.|我在中国吃过很多菜，都很好吃。|I have eaten many dishes in China; they were all delicious.

你喜欢什么味道的菜？|What flavours do you like in food?|我喜欢甜的东西，比如蛋糕。|I like sweet things, such as cake.|我喜欢有一点儿甜的菜。|I like dishes that are a little sweet.|我喜欢妈妈做的菜，什么都喜欢。|I like my mother's cooking; I like everything she makes.

你在中国生过病吗？生病后，你是怎么做的？|Have you been ill in China? What did you do afterwards?|我感冒过。我去医院看了医生。|I have had a cold. I went to hospital to see a doctor.|我有一次头疼，就在家休息了。|I once had a headache, so I rested at home.|我没有感冒过。我每天都运动。|I have not had a cold. I exercise every day.

你在中国的医院看过病吗？看病的过程中有没有遇到什么问题？|Have you seen a doctor in a Chinese hospital? Did you encounter any problems?|我去过。有些话听不懂，朋友帮了我。|I have. I could not understand some things, and a friend helped.|我还没有去过，所以不太了解。|I have not been yet, so I do not know much about it.|我去过。医生说得很慢，我听懂了。|I have. The doctor spoke slowly and I understood.

你最想做什么工作？为什么？|What job would you most like to do, and why?|我想当老师，因为我喜欢孩子。|I want to be a teacher because I like children.|我想当医生，因为可以帮助别人。|I want to be a doctor because I can help others.|我想在国际公司工作，因为可以认识不同的人。|I want to work in an international company because I can meet different people.

你觉得刚开始工作时，要注意什么？|What should you pay attention to when starting work?|我觉得要按时到公司，不要迟到。|I think you should arrive at work on time and not be late.|不懂的地方要问，不能随便做。|Ask about things you do not understand; do not act carelessly.|要多学习，也要和同事好好交流。|Learn more and communicate well with colleagues.

压力大时，你会怎样放松自己？|How do you relax when you feel stressed?|我会出去走走，也会听音乐。|I go for a walk and listen to music.|我喜欢和朋友一起吃饭、聊天儿。|I like eating and chatting with friends.|我会早点儿睡觉，第二天再工作。|I go to sleep early and work again the next day.

外出游玩时，你喜欢看风景还是参观历史文化景点？|On outings, do you prefer scenery or historical and cultural places?|我喜欢看山和水，因为很安静。|I like looking at mountains and water because it is peaceful.|我喜欢了解历史，所以常去有名的地方。|I like learning about history, so I often visit famous places.|两种我都喜欢，看时间怎么安排。|I like both; it depends on how the time is arranged.

生日这天你一般都怎么过？|How do you usually spend your birthday?|我一般和家人一起吃饭。|I usually eat with my family.|我会请朋友来家里，一起吃蛋糕。|I invite friends home and we eat cake together.|我喜欢安静地过生日，给妈妈打个电话。|I like a quiet birthday and call my mother.

你和好朋友是怎么认识的？你们经常见面吗？|How did you meet your close friend? Do you meet often?|我们在学校认识，每天都见面。|We met at school and see each other every day.|我们在工作时认识，周末常一起吃饭。|We met at work and often eat together on weekends.|我们是邻居，有时间就见面。|We are neighbours and meet when we have time.

你住的地方气候怎么样？对你们的生活有什么影响？|What is the climate like where you live, and how does it affect your life?|我住的地方很热，所以我们常开空调。|It is hot where I live, so we often use air conditioning.|我们这里冬天很冷，出门要多穿衣服。|Winter is cold here, so we wear more clothes outside.|这里经常下雨，所以我总带着雨伞。|It rains often here, so I always carry an umbrella.

你喜欢比较冷还是比较热的天气？为什么？|Do you prefer colder or hotter weather, and why?|我喜欢热一点儿，因为可以游泳。|I prefer it warmer because I can swim.|我喜欢冷一点儿，因为可以看雪。|I prefer it colder because I can see snow.|我喜欢不冷不热的天气，出去玩很舒服。|I like mild weather because it is comfortable for outings.
